master:medicine.overview: The 6-year MD programme at Medical University of Varna provides comprehensive medical education combining pre-clinical sciences with extensive clinical rotations at University Hospital St. Marina.
master:medicine.keyFocus: pre-clinical sciences, clinical medicine, diagnostics, patient care, medical ethics
highlights: Modern simulation center with high-fidelity mannequins
admissionNotes: Strong background in Biology and Chemistry required
Entrance exams in Biology and Chemistry for BG-language program
English-taught track requires IELTS/TOEFL and science proficiency

master:medicine-english.overview: The English-taught MD programme at Medical University of Varna offers international students a 6-year medical degree with the same rigorous curriculum as the Bulgarian track.
master:medicine-english.keyFocus: clinical medicine, diagnostics, patient care, international health standards
admissionNotes: Secondary school diploma with strong science grades
Separate application process for international students

master:dental-medicine.overview: The 6-year DMD programme at Medical University of Varna trains students in oral health, dental surgery, and maxillofacial medicine with extensive clinical practice.
master:dental-medicine.keyFocus: oral health, dental surgery, orthodontics, prosthodontics, maxillofacial surgery
partners: University Hospital St. Marina - Dental Clinic
highlights: Pre-clinical training in phantom head lab
Clinical rotations in university dental clinic
admissionNotes: Biology and Chemistry entrance exams for BG track
Manual dexterity and spatial awareness important
English-taught track available for international students

master:dental-medicine-english.overview: The English-taught DMD programme at MU-Varna offers international students a 6-year dental medicine degree with comprehensive clinical training.
master:dental-medicine-english.keyFocus: oral health, dental surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics

master:pharmacy.overview: The 5-year Pharmacy (MSc) programme at Medical University of Varna prepares students for careers in pharmaceutical sciences, drug development, and community pharmacy.
master:pharmacy.keyFocus: pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacology, drug formulation, clinical pharmacy, regulatory affairs
highlights: Drug analysis and quality control training
admissionNotes: Entrance exams in Chemistry and Biology for BG track

master:pharmacy-english.overview: The English-taught Pharmacy MSc programme at MU-Varna provides international students with comprehensive pharmaceutical education over 5 years.
master:pharmacy-english.keyFocus: pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacology, drug formulation, clinical pharmacy

master:military-medicine.overview: The Military Medicine programme is a joint specialisation between MU-Varna, the Military Medical Academy, and the Naval Academy, combining medical education with military leadership.
master:military-medicine.keyFocus: military medicine, disaster medicine, tactical medicine, leadership
highlights: Dual degree: MD + Military Organisation Management
Military leadership and tactical medicine training
Guaranteed career placement in military medical service

bachelor:nursing.overview: The 4-year Nursing Bachelor programme at Medical University of Varna trains compassionate, skilled nurses for clinical practice in hospitals, clinics, and community health settings.
bachelor:nursing.keyFocus: patient care, clinical nursing, health assessment, pharmacology, community health
admissionNotes: No tuition fees for this programme

bachelor:midwifery.overview: The 4-year Midwifery Bachelor programme at Medical University of Varna prepares students for professional midwifery practice in hospitals, clinics, and community settings.
bachelor:midwifery.keyFocus: maternal care, neonatal care, reproductive health, women's health
admissionNotes: No tuition fees for this programme

master:public-health-mph.overview: The MPH programme at Medical University of Varna equips students with skills in epidemiology, biostatistics, health policy, and disease prevention.
master:public-health-mph.keyFocus: epidemiology, biostatistics, health policy, disease prevention, global health
admissionNotes: Bachelor degree in health or social sciences required

master:health-care-management-master.overview: The Health Care Management Master programme at MU-Varna prepares health professionals for leadership roles in healthcare organizations.
master:health-care-management-master.keyFocus: healthcare administration, health policy, quality management, health economics
admissionNotes: Bachelor degree in health sciences or management required
